sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "player_award"."player_id" AS e, "player"."bats" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "player_award" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "player_award"."player_id"  GROUP BY "player_award"."player_id", "player"."bats"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT SUM("s2"."m1") AS v FROM "s2"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s2"."m1" AS REAL) / "s3"."v") AS m2 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m2") AS v FROM "s4") SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, ("s4"."m2" - "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s4"."m2" > "s5"."v"
construction: agg:player within player.bats > agg:g > share:all > baseline:all
why: share of the all total of total of number of player_award records (all level)
gap to the all average of total of number of player_award records: share of the all total (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "batting_postseason"."team_id" AS e, SUM(("batting_postseason"."bb" - "batting_postseason"."ibb")) AS m1 FROM "batting_postseason" GROUP BY "batting_postseason"."team_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v") SELECT AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5"
